implementation_summary: Added local MCP-style serve tool responses for recall, coverage, and assess while preserving the command-result envelope.
Recall returns active accepted rules with statement, lifecycle status, confidence, and resolved GitHub PR citations.
Coverage reports covered_risky, covered_clean, and no_coverage out-of-distribution responses for repo-relative paths.
Serve tool calls expose agent-facing boundaries: active memory only, human-review approval required, citations required, no hosted service, and no live network.
Documented the T12 serve tool behavior in README and repo dev/architecture guides.
objective: Implement PRD-defined MCP tools, recall behavior, coverage/OOD responses, active-memory serving rules, and agent-facing access boundaries.
